name: watchdog-stall
goal: Breakage test of the watchdog: nobody votes and the vote gets a 10 s budget (5 s idle): every process journals watchdog.slow then watchdog.stall with what it waits on, then fails as 'watchdog: … stalled' WITH a report (not a launcher kill), and the launcher relays the alerts to alerts.log as they happen.

expect.cmd: python -X utf8 Packages/com.unpseudo.autoplay/Tools~/check_alerts.py {run} "WATCHDOG.SLOW host-" "WATCHDOG.STALL host-" "RUN.FAIL host-[^ ]+ watchdog: phase"
